description: Tesserae V6 data files not included in the Git repository. Run scripts/download_data.py to fetch these automatically.

files.description: Latin inverted index (the live search index, rebuilt 18 October 2026 after the Latin lemma corrections)
Greek inverted index (the live search index, 18 October 2026)
Latin syntax parses from LatinPipe (1,429 texts, 542,311 lines of UD annotations)
files.rebuild_instructions: Run build_latinpipe_syntax.py on Marvin with local LatinPipe model (~1-2 hours)

files.description: Greek syntax parses (650 texts, UD annotations for syntax channel)
Coptic inverted index (Sahidic and Bohairic, 153 texts; the Sahidica New Testament is left out, see Coptic Scriptorium)
Biblical Hebrew inverted index (Tanakh, 39 books; BHSA, CC BY-NC 4.0)
Coptic dependency parses, for the syntax channels

Text of 460,652 passage windows and the lines of each work. Republished 19 October 2026 without the 25 Sahidica New Testament works, the Arabic and Persian works and eleven Iqbal collections. Each work keeps its own license and the whole is non-commercial because it includes the Hebrew Bible. The archive also holds LICENSE.txt and README.txt.

Urdu inverted index of 14 Urdu Wikisource collections, CC BY-SA 4.0, without the four Iqbal collections. Copy ur_index.db to data/inverted_index/ to use it. The archive also holds LICENSE.txt and README.txt.
files.rebuild_instructions: Not rebuilt by a script. See docs/DATA_OPERATIONS.md, the entry of 2026-10-19 for the data sets added to the Downloads page.

notes.total_size: about 8 GB uncompressed for the search indexes and syntax databases
notes.hosting: Files are hosted on the Tesserae server (tesserae.caset.buffalo.edu) and served via Apache.
notes.checksums: SHA256 checksums are of the extracted file; the page also carries SHA256SUMS.txt over the archives. Regenerated 19 October 2026 for la, grc, en, he and fa.
notes.passage_index: The passage window index (Theme Search, Similar Passages) ships as per-language slices on the download page, passage_index_<lang>.tar.gz with index.json, because the slices differ in licence (Hebrew CC BY-NC, Coptic CC BY, the rest public domain or Ganjoor). Reassemble with scripts/merge_index.py. The single passage_index.tar.gz of 2 September 2026 was withdrawn on 19 October 2026.
notes.checksums_added_2026_10_19: For the ten entries added on 19 October 2026 (and the window_texts entry as updated), sha256 is the checksum of the archive, which download_data.py verifies, and sha256_extracted is the checksum of the first extracted file.
